title: CaRE：掩码扩散语言模型的计算感知重掩码评估协议
summary: CaRE是一个计算感知评估框架，通过标准化实际函数评估次数、强制多指标报告并显式控制随机性，审计掩码扩散语言模型的重掩码策略。应用于7种策略后发现：温度解释大部分MAUVE方差；计算匹配比较逆转了多个已发表策略排名；高熵重掩码在特定条件下显著降低MAUVE。该框架确保未来重掩码声明可复现和可比较。
summary_en: CaRE is a compute-aware evaluation framework that audits MDLM remasking strategies by standardizing actual NFE, enforcing multi-metric reporting, and explicitly controlling stochasticity. Applied to 7 strategies, it reveals that temperature explains most MAUVE variance, compute-matched comparisons reverse several published rankings, and high-entropy remasking reduces MAUVE significantly. The framework ensures future remasking claims are reproducible and comparable.
